Module np.cincuentazo
Package np.cincuentazo.controller

Class TurnController

java.lang.Object
np.cincuentazo.controller.TurnController
public class TurnController extends Object
Manages the turn cycle of a Cincuentazo game session.

On each turn:

  • Human player: checks whether a valid play exists. If not, the player is immediately eliminated and the turn advances. If yes, starts the TurnTimerThread via GameController.startHumanTurnTimer() so the human has a fixed window to act before being auto-eliminated.
  • Machine player: starts a MachinePlayerThread that introduces the required 2â€“4 s delay before the machine plays (HU-3).

All callbacks from MachinePlayerThread and TurnTimerThread are posted to the JavaFX Application Thread before reaching GameController, so no extra synchronisation is required here.

  • Method Details

    • processTurn

      public void processTurn()
      Evaluates the current player and initiates the appropriate action. Must be called on the JavaFX Application Thread.

      Always refreshes the view first so the board reflects the new current player before any thread or timer is launched.

    • stopCurrentThread

      public void stopCurrentThread()
      Interrupts and discards the currently running machine thread, if any. Safe to call even when no thread is active.
